'expected' is what extract() SHOULD produce for this exact anchor occurrence; qism is recorded for documentation but is NOT part of score_gold.py's headline precision/recall (qism isn't consumed by any downstream table/view yet -- see DAILY_REVIEW.md backlog 'Qism-level (article-part) grain'). Batch 1 (gold_id 0-49, seed 20260920, built 2026-09-20): read window-by-window against the raw Uzbek text and citation_extractor.py's own stop-word/anchor rules (see DAILY_REVIEW.md 2026-09-20 log entry for the reasoning behind each verdict, especially the self_reference-without-article-number 'correctly empty' cases and the gazette-locator 'correctly bare act' cases). Every record is 'verdict: correct' -- this batch found no new extractor bug (the first sample in this project's 9-session sampling history not to). Batch 2 (gold_id 50-99, seed 20260922, built 2026-09-22, disjoint from batch 1): same read-by-hand method. 49/50 records are 'verdict: correct'; one (gold_id 52, row 46605) is 'verdict: known_gap' -- a documented, unfixed extractor limitation (a LexUZ 'paragrafi'->'paragrifi' misspelling isn't recognized as the paragraf unit word) recorded with its true expected output so it scores as an honest recall miss rather than being silently marked correct. See DAILY_REVIEW.md 2026-09-22 log entry and Backlog. Batch 3 (gold_id 100-139, built 2026-09-25, drawn by build_gold_sample_novel.py's signature-stratified sampler instead of a fourth uniform-random batch -- see DAILY_REVIEW.md 2026-09-25 for why): 38/40 'verdict: correct' (including one real bug this batch found and fixed at the source, gold_id 108), 2/40 'verdict: known_gap' (a Roman-numeral chapter+paragraf section-grain loss, gold_id 123; the pre-existing qism-grain limitation now also measured in comma-list form, not just the previously-known dash-range form, gold_id 131). Batch 4 (gold_id 140-179, seed 20260928, built 2026-09-28): second signature-stratified round. 38/40 verdict: correct, 2/40 known_gap -- both reconfirmations of already-documented backlog gaps rather than new bugs (the “hamda” list-separator gap, row 24219; the chapter+paragraph-list-with-parenthetical gap, row 25634), each formalized here for the first time as a permanent regression record. One more window (gold_id 170) also re-hit the already-known “boʻlim”-not-a-recognized-unit gap but is scored ’correct’, not ’known_gap’, since the schema has no field at all to record an honest mismatch against (same treatment as qism). Batch 5 (gold_id 180-219, seed 20260928002, built 2026-09-28): a second, disjoint draw the same day after batch 4 found nothing new, to give the “no new bug” result a second, independent check. 37/40 correct, 3/40 known_gap: one NEW gap found and formalized (gold_id 194-196, row 37948 -- a bare article number immediately followed by a different code’s own name loses its unit word to that other code’s clause, silently dropping Civil Code Article 38; measured corpus-wide at exactly 5 raw occurrences across 3 rows, all the same target article -- see Backlog), plus two more ’correct’ boʻlim re-hits (gold_id 186 and 200, same schema-cannot-express reasoning as batch 4’s). Batch 6 (gold_id 220-259, seed 20260929, built 2026-09-29): third signature-stratified round. 40/40 verdict: correct -- but 2 of the 40 (row 43534, row 44469) only score correct because a real, live recall bug found while hand-reading this batch was fixed at the source before merging: RE_STOP's 'axborotnoma' (gazette publication-record) branch is a whole-window `break`, and when the Code's OWN bibliographic parenthetical -- e.g. 'Fuqarolik kodeksi (Oʻzbekiston Respublikasi Oliy Majlisining Axborotnomasi, 1996-yil, ...) 775-moddasining ikkinchi qismidagi ...' -- sits between the anchor and the real target article, the parenthetical's own internal gazette-item locators ('56-modda') are themselves RE_CLAUSE matches whose gap contains 'Axborotnomasi', so the break fires on the very first candidate and discards the real citation that follows the closing paren too. Fixed in citation_extractor.py by blanking a leading, balanced, signal-bearing parenthetical before the clause scan starts (RE_LEADING_PUB_PAREN), scoped to only the parenthetical immediately after the anchor. Measured corpus-wide: 9 rows recovered (articles 15, 38, 43, 48, 53, 292, 775, 788, 1015), 0 regressions (score_gold.py unchanged at 693/700 precision, 693/703 recall on the pre-existing 220 records). See DAILY_REVIEW.md 2026-09-29 for the full measurement. Batch 7 (gold_id 260-299, seed 20261002, signature-stratified via build_gold_sample_novel.py, built 2026-10-02): all 40 verdict 'correct' against the CURRENT (fixed) extractor -- the batch's own reading surfaced the 'boʻlim' part-level gap at 2 of its 40 windows (rows 46656, 48850), which this same session fixed (RE_ROMAN_PART in citation_extractor.py), so both score as correct against the new behavior rather than as known_gap.
